name: Espresso
description: Pressure brewing a compact coffee beverage through a puck of finely ground coffee.

name: Pour over
description: Manual percolation in which water passes through a coffee bed and filter.

name: Batch brew
description: Automatic or scheduled filter brewing in a batch brewer.

name: French press
description: Immersion brewing followed by filtration with a plunger.

name: AeroPress
description: Pressure-assisted immersion brewing in an AeroPress-style brewer.

name: Moka pot
description: Stovetop percolation through coffee using steam pressure.

name: Siphon
description: Vacuum brewing that moves water between chambers through a coffee bed.

name: Cold brew
description: Long contact brewing with cool or room-temperature water.

name: Cezve
description: Boiling finely ground coffee in a cezve or similar small pot.

name: Percolator
description: Repeated percolation of heated water through a coffee bed.

name: Capsule
description: Brewing coffee from a pre-portioned capsule or pod.
